title: Cut vs. Bulk Diagnostic & Phase Periodization Blueprint
audience: Lifters planning a cut or bulk
core_problem: Lifters planning a cut or bulk face a related cluster of problems around cut vs. bulk diagnostic & phase periodization blueprint — e.g. Uncertainty in choosing between cutting and bulking phase, Ineffective muscle growth due to short bulk/cut cycles.
desired_outcome: Clear, objective clarity on whether to start with a cut, bulk, or recomp, along with a structured 8–12 month phase roadmap to eliminate decision anxiety.
primary_question: Do real people experience this problem, what does it look like, what outcome do they want, what have they tried, what remains unsolved?
